key_insight: ROGUE-AI shows that harmful agent behavior often stems from overlooked operational hazards rather than malicious instructions.
engineering_relevance: Release audits should test ordinary workflow hazards alongside prompt injection, using matched controls to isolate suspected causes.
method: Reconstruct reported agent incidents offline with a multi-agent framework.
Compare each reconstruction with a matched control lacking only the blamed cause.
Evaluate five models and test hazard-specific warnings after tool outputs.
evidence_signal: ROGUE-AI reproduced reported harm in 89% of 108 attempted replications; across five models, mistake rates were 18–33% with the blamed cause versus at most 1% without it.
watch_item: Offline reconstructions may not fully capture production conditions, so results require validation in representative deployment environments.
paper_title: Replication of Agentic Security Events: Audit and Investigation (ROGUE-AI)
